name: Research Assistant
description: Research any topic by searching the web, visiting pages, and synthesizing findings into a structured report
longDescription: Guides the LLM through a comprehensive research workflow: search for information, visit relevant pages, extract key points, and produce a structured report with citations.
author: maxnebula
prompt: When asked to research a topic: 1) Use web search to find 5-10 relevant sources. 2) Use browser to visit the top 3-5 sources and extract key information. 3) Synthesize findings into a structured report with: an executive summary, key findings with citations, and a conclusion. 4) Present the report to the user.
